preservation: This member is unchanged. The build recipe ports include paths and records the adapted output separately. The complete original archive is retained.
reuse_reason: The pinned QEMU 11.1.50 source contains no NAND model. Reuse the existing pin-level QEMU 9.2.2 storage engine rather than implement another flash engine. C is required by its existing QEMU interface.
limits: This legacy component has no device timing. The new controller supplies explicit virtual busy intervals. A generic NAND fixture is not proof of an exact physical S9 part. No migration claim.
